title: Costs
subtitle: Everything the vehicle cost over the period

empty.title: No costs in this period
empty.body: Charges, tolls, servicing, insurance and other costs of this vehicle appear here once they are entered or synced.

estimateNote: Excludes estimated energy and upcoming instalments, which have no line.

tollInvoice.title: Toll invoices
tollInvoice.hint: The monthly invoice replaces the tolls entered or estimated on the trips of its month in the totals. Trips and carpools keep their own tolls.
tollInvoice.loadError: The invoices could not be loaded.
tollInvoice.intro: The total billed for the month. In the totals, it takes the place of the tolls entered or estimated on the trips of the month; the trips keep theirs.
tollInvoice.totalHelp: 0 when the month had no toll.
tollInvoice.onTrips: Tolls on the trips of the month

preview.unattached: The invoice holds {amount} of tolls that no trip carries.
preview.lower: The trips record {amount} more than the invoice.

tollInvoice.deleteConfirm: Delete the toll invoice of {month}? The month goes back to counting the tolls entered on its trips.
tollInvoice.saveError: The invoice could not be saved
